proposal.description: Supervisor's soft-start overcurrent input is wired to the RUN window trip, so the S_SS -> S_HICCUP exit is driven by a trip that fault_arbiter only raises in S_RUN
proposal.reason: With CP_trig asserted on enough cycles in S_SS to reach trip_ss, the reference leaves S_SS for S_HICCUP and drops En. The mutant stays in S_SS with En high and PWM_out switching, and never counts a strike.

proposal.description: fault_cause's soft-start overcurrent cause is fed from the RUN window trip, so an overcurrent hiccup out of S_SS is not logged
proposal.reason: After a window_trip_SS hiccup in S_SS, a host read of the fault-cause register (0x20) gives an OC bit of 0 and a fault_time of 0, where the reference reports OC set and the timestamp of the trip.

proposal.description: soft_start holds its ramped ceiling while PGOOD is asserted instead of while the supervisor is in S_RUN, so 'running' is taken to mean 'rail qualified good'
proposal.reason: After SS_done the FSM enters S_RUN, but PGOOD is still qualifying, so soft_start falls into its reset branch and drops max_on_counts back to MIN_ON_COUNTS. Until PGOOD asserts, and again after any PGOOD_comp dip, PWM_out pulses are cut to the minimum on-time instead of max_on_limit.

proposal.description: fault_cause logs the undebounced synchronised UVLO flag instead of the debounced copy the supervisor acts on
proposal.reason: A UVLO_trig pulse in S_SS or S_RUN that is shorter than the debounce assert time does not stop the converter, but the mutant sets the UVLO bit and fault_time in the fault-cause register. The reference logs nothing.

proposal.description: strike_counter counts a strike on every gate-driver shutdown (En falling, or low at reset) instead of on each entry into S_HICCUP
proposal.reason: Right after reset, and on every switch-off, OTP or UVLO shutdown, strike_level steps up with no hiccup. Red_LED1 blinks, the next hiccup's back-off is longer, and enough plain switch off/on cycles assert latch_out.
